name: de.mapumi/wunschzettel
title: mapumi: little helpers for families
description: Free family helpers, no account: kids' wish lists with gift reservation, birthday invites with RSVP

tools.name: create_wishlist
tools.description: Create a new wish list for a child, optionally with first wishes. Returns edit_link (secret, for parents) and share_link (for family).

occasion.description: Free text, any culture or religion, e.g. "Geburtstag", "Weihnachten", "Eid al-Fitr", "Diwali".

date.description: Date of the occasion as YYYY-MM-DD (optional).

message.description: Optional message from the parents to everyone giving gifts, shown above the wishes. Line breaks are kept. Empty string removes it.

text.description: The wish, short and concrete, e.g. "IKEA RELATERA desk, white". No price, shop or ISBN here: use price and link. Optional if a link is given: then the product title is used.

link.description: Optional product link. The product picture (and title, if text is empty) is fetched from the page.

price.description: Price as text, e.g. "39,99 €". Always set it when you know the price (never write it into text): it is the target when relatives chip in. Filled from the product page when a link is given and price is empty. Empty string removes it.

image_url.description: Optional direct URL of the main product picture (https://…jpg/png/webp), e.g. the og:image of the product page if you have seen it. Used when the picture cannot be fetched from the page, many shops block our server. Empty string removes it.

tools.name: get_wishlist
tools.description: Read a wish list. Works with an edit link (owner view, includes edit_link) or a share link (family view). Both show which wishes are reserved and the optional name of who reserved them.

tools.name: add_wishes
tools.description: Add one or more wishes to a list. Needs the edit link.

edit_link.description: The secret edit link (https://wunschzettel.mapumi.de/b/…) or just its key.

text.description: The wish, short and concrete, e.g. "IKEA RELATERA desk, white". No price, shop or ISBN here: use price and link. Optional if a link is given: then the product title is used.

link.description: Optional product link. The product picture (and title, if text is empty) is fetched from the page.

price.description: Price as text, e.g. "39,99 €". Always set it when you know the price (never write it into text): it is the target when relatives chip in. Filled from the product page when a link is given and price is empty. Empty string removes it.

image_url.description: Optional direct URL of the main product picture (https://…jpg/png/webp), e.g. the og:image of the product page if you have seen it. Used when the picture cannot be fetched from the page, many shops block our server. Empty string removes it.

tools.name: update_wish
tools.description: Change text, link, price, picture (image_url) or favorite of one wish. Only given fields change. A new link fetches picture and price again unless price is given too. Needs the edit link.

edit_link.description: The secret edit link (https://wunschzettel.mapumi.de/b/…) or just its key.

text.description: The wish, short and concrete, e.g. "IKEA RELATERA desk, white". No price, shop or ISBN here: use price and link. Optional if a link is given: then the product title is used.

link.description: Optional product link. The product picture (and title, if text is empty) is fetched from the page.

price.description: Price as text, e.g. "39,99 €". Always set it when you know the price (never write it into text): it is the target when relatives chip in. Filled from the product page when a link is given and price is empty. Empty string removes it.

image_url.description: Optional direct URL of the main product picture (https://…jpg/png/webp), e.g. the og:image of the product page if you have seen it. Used when the picture cannot be fetched from the page, many shops block our server. Empty string removes it.

tools.name: remove_wish
tools.description: Remove one wish from the list. Needs the edit link.

edit_link.description: The secret edit link (https://wunschzettel.mapumi.de/b/…) or just its key.

tools.name: update_wishlist
tools.description: Change child name, occasion, date or the message to gift givers. Only given fields change. Needs the edit link.

edit_link.description: The secret edit link (https://wunschzettel.mapumi.de/b/…) or just its key.

occasion.description: Free text, any culture or religion, e.g. "Geburtstag", "Weihnachten", "Eid al-Fitr", "Diwali".

date.description: Date of the occasion as YYYY-MM-DD (optional).

message.description: Optional message from the parents to everyone giving gifts, shown above the wishes. Line breaks are kept. Empty string removes it.

tools.name: delete_wishlist
tools.description: Delete the whole list for good, including all reservations. Ask the user before calling. Needs the edit link.

edit_link.description: The secret edit link (https://wunschzettel.mapumi.de/b/…) or just its key.

tools.name: reserve_wish
tools.description: For relatives: mark a wish as "I'll give this" so nobody else buys it. Returns a reservation_token; keep it to undo with release_wish. Needs the share link.

share_link.description: The share link (https://wunschzettel.mapumi.de/z/…) or just its id.

name.description: Optional name of who gets the gift, e.g. "Oma Rosi". Shown to parents and family.

tools.name: release_wish
tools.description: Undo your own reservation. Needs the share link and the reservation_token from reserve_wish.

share_link.description: The share link (https://wunschzettel.mapumi.de/z/…) or just its id.

tools.name: contribute_to_wish
tools.description: For relatives: pledge a part of the price of a wish, so several people can give it together. Only for wishes with a price that nobody reserved, up to what is still missing (see target_amount and collected_amount in get_wishlist). Nothing is paid here. Returns contribution_id and contribution_token; keep both to undo with withdraw_contribution. Needs the share link.

share_link.description: The share link (https://wunschzettel.mapumi.de/z/…) or just its id.

amount.description: Amount in the currency of the price, e.g. 20 or 12.50.

name.description: Optional name of who chips in, e.g. "Oma Rosi". Shown to parents and family, the amount only to the parents.

tools.name: withdraw_contribution
tools.description: Take back your own pledged amount. Needs the share link, contribution_id and contribution_token from contribute_to_wish.

share_link.description: The share link (https://wunschzettel.mapumi.de/z/…) or just its id.

tools.name: create_party
tools.description: Create a birthday party invitation with personal links for each guest. Returns edit_link (secret, for parents) and guests with their guest_link.

child_name.description: First name of the birthday child.

date.description: Party day as YYYY-MM-DD, today up to one year ahead.

place.description: Where, shown to all guests, e.g. "bei uns zu Hause" (optional).

address.description: Full address, shown to a guest only after they said yes (optional).

notes.description: Notes for the parents of the guests, e.g. pickup time, what to bring (optional).

wishlist_link.description: Share link of the child's wish list (https://wunschzettel.mapumi.de/z/…), optional. Empty string removes it.

guests.description: First names of the invited children.

tools.name: get_party
tools.description: With the edit link: the party and every guest with their answer (yes, no or open), allergies, siblings and pickup, plus counts. With a guest link: that guest's own invitation only.

link.description: Party edit link or guest link.

tools.name: add_guests
tools.description: Invite more children. Each gets their own guest_link. Needs the party edit link.

edit_link.description: The secret party edit link (https://www.mapumi.de/einladung/e/…) or just its key.

guests.description: First names of the invited children.

tools.name: remove_guest
tools.description: Take a guest off the list. Their link stops working. Needs the party edit link.

edit_link.description: The secret party edit link (https://www.mapumi.de/einladung/e/…) or just its key.

tools.name: update_party
tools.description: Change name, age, date, times, place, address, notes or wish list link. Only given fields change. Needs the party edit link.

edit_link.description: The secret party edit link (https://www.mapumi.de/einladung/e/…) or just its key.

child_name.description: First name of the birthday child.

date.description: Party day as YYYY-MM-DD, today up to one year ahead.

place.description: Where, shown to all guests, e.g. "bei uns zu Hause" (optional).

address.description: Full address, shown to a guest only after they said yes (optional).

notes.description: Notes for the parents of the guests, e.g. pickup time, what to bring (optional).

wishlist_link.description: Share link of the child's wish list (https://wunschzettel.mapumi.de/z/…), optional. Empty string removes it.

tools.name: delete_party
tools.description: Delete the invitation and all answers for good. Guest links stop working. Ask the user before calling. Needs the party edit link.

edit_link.description: The secret party edit link (https://www.mapumi.de/einladung/e/…) or just its key.

tools.name: answer_invitation
tools.description: For the invited family: say yes or no. With yes, optional allergies, siblings coming along and who picks up. Returns the invitation, with the address after a yes. Needs the guest link.

guest_link.description: The guest link (https://www.mapumi.de/einladung/g/…) or just its id.
